description_en: Queries statistics on automatic SQL optimization events within a period of time, such as the total number of optimization events and the maximum improvement
description_zh: 调用GetInstanceSqlOptimizeStatistic接口，获取指定时间段内自动SQL优化任务的统计数据，包括任务总数和最大收益等
name: GetInstanceSqlOptimizeStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID.

The database instance must be an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

仅支持RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL Cluster Edition instances or PolarDB for MySQL clusters, you must specify the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于RDS MySQL集群系列数据库实例或PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The duration threshold for automatic SQL optimization events. After this parameter is specified, the system collects statistics on automatic SQL optimization events whose duration does not exceed the specified threshold.

This parameter is a reserved parameter and does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
自动SQL优化事件的持续时间阈值。
设置此参数后，只会统计持续时间不超过阈值的自动SQL优化事件。

此参数为备用参数，当前暂不生效
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter instances for which DAS Enterprise Edition is enabled. Valid values:

true

false

If you set this parameter to true, only database instances for which DAS Enterprise Edition is disabled are queried. If you set this parameter to false, all database instances are queried
parameters.help_zh:
是否过滤开启了DAS企业版的数据库实例：
true：是。
false：否。

取值为true时，只统计未开启DAS企业版的数据库实例；取值为false时，统计所有数据库实例
parameters.name: filter_enable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to merge automatic SQL optimization events. Valid values:

true: merges automatic SQL optimization events.

false: does not merge automatic SQL optimization events.

This parameter is a reserved parameter and does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
是否合并事件：
true：是。
false：否。

此参数为备用参数，当前暂不生效
parameters.name: use_merging

Data.description_en: The details of the automatic SQL optimization events

count.description_en: The total number of automatic SQL optimization events

improvement.description_en: The multiple of the maximum improvement for returned automatic SQL optimization events
improvement.description_zh: 返回的自动SQL优化事件中，SQL优化后的最大收益倍数

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
